taken.title: Card taken on the previous turn
taken.intro: {player} took this card on the previous turn:
taken.location: {player} took this card on the previous turn and keeps it in hand.

location.animal-deck: In an Animal deck, face down.
location.animal-offer: Face up on top of a deck: the loser of the next duel will choose between the two face-up cards.

hidden.title: Animal card
hidden.intro: There are 24 Animal cards: 3 families (Elephant, Tiger and Mouse), each numbered from 1 to 8.
hidden.set-aside: At the start of each round, 4 of them are set aside at random, face down, without anyone seeing them: they are not played during the round. Even counting the cards already played, you can never be sure which ones remain in the decks or in your opponent’s hand.

elephant.title: Elephant {value}
elephant.duel: The Elephant beats the Tiger, but is beaten by the Mouse.
elephant.palace: Gain 1 Favor per Elephant in your Palace, including the one you just placed.
elephant.jungle: You may move 1 animal from the Jungle to the Palace, yours or your opponent’s. It can be the Elephant you just played.

tiger.title: Tiger {value}
tiger.duel: The Tiger beats the Mouse, but is beaten by the Elephant.
tiger.palace: Gain 1 Favor per Tiger in your Jungle. Then draw 1 Character card.
tiger.jungle: You may move 1 animal from the Palace to the Jungle, yours or your opponent’s.

mouse.title: Mouse {value}
mouse.duel: The Mouse beats the Elephant, but is beaten by the Tiger.
mouse.palace: Gain 1 Honor and 1 Favor per pair of Mice in your Palace, including the one you just completed.

animal.same-family: If both animals belong to the same family, the highest value wins the duel.
animal.collection: A moved animal does not trigger the effect of the place it arrives in. Gather 4 consecutive values in your Palace or your Jungle to win a Collection.

character.hidden.intro: There are 8 Character cards: the Merchant, the Maharaja, the Thief and the Hunter, each with a bet on winning and a bet on losing.

effect.12: Duel lost: gain 1 Favor and 1 Honor.
effect.21: Duel won: move any animal from the Palace to the Jungle, or the other way around (yours or your opponent’s). The moved animal does not trigger the effect of the place.
effect.22: Duel lost: gain 1 Favor, then move any animal from the Palace to the Jungle, or the other way around (yours or your opponent’s). The moved animal does not trigger the effect of the place.
effect.31: Duel won: take 1 animal from your opponent’s Jungle and place it in your own Jungle, without triggering the effect of the place.
effect.32: Duel lost: take 1 animal from your opponent’s Palace and place it in your own Palace, without triggering the effect of the place.
effect.41: Duel won: gain 1 Favor and eliminate 1 of your opponent’s animals (in their Palace or Jungle). That animal is discarded.
effect.42: Duel lost: gain 1 Honor and eliminate 1 of your opponent’s animals (in their Palace or Jungle). That animal is discarded.

rule.play: You may play only one Character card, face down, per duel, in addition to your Animal card.
rule.reveal: Bet won: activate the card before or after your Animal card, then discard it. Bet lost: discard it without effect.
rule.limit: You may only keep two Character cards in hand: if you draw a 3rd one, discard one.
rule.draw: Unplayed Character cards stay in hand from one round to the next.

palace.title: Palace Collection
palace.intro: Won by the first player who gathers 4 consecutive values in their Palace, regardless of the animals and their order.

jungle.title: Jungle Collection
jungle.intro: Won by the first player who gathers 4 consecutive values in their Jungle, regardless of the animals and their order.

collection.gain: {favor, plural, =0 {} one {# Favor} other {# Favor}}{honor, plural, =0 {} one { and # Honor} other { and # Honor}}

rule.check: Each player checks their Collections after resolving their effects. The winner of the duel checks before the loser.
rule.once: Once won, a token is no longer available for the rest of the round.
rule.faces: At the start of each round, the visible side of the token is decided by a coin toss.

collection.won.mine: You won it for this round.

favor.title: Favor
favor.intro: Prestige tokens on their white side are Favor points. They count towards your Prestige, but are lost at the end of the round.

honor.title: Honor
honor.intro: Prestige tokens on their black side are Honor points. They count towards your Prestige, break ties, and become Favor for the next round.

rule.total: Favor + Honor = Prestige. The player with the most Prestige wins the round.
rule.tie: In case of a tie, the player with the most Honor wins. If the tie persists, the players reveal the last card in their hand: the winner of this final duel wins the round.
rule.after: “Favor fades, but Honor endures!” Favor is discarded, and Honor becomes Favor already earned for the next round.

prestige.change: Tokens are worth 1, 3 or 6: the supply is unlimited and change is made automatically.

prestige-total.title: Prestige
prestige-total.intro: A player’s Prestige is the sum of their Favor (white tokens) and their Honor (black tokens). It decides the winner of each round.

gain.palace: Palace effects: each won duel places your card in the Palace, and its effect earns Favor, and Honor for pairs of Mice.
gain.characters: Some Character cards, such as the Merchant, directly earn Favor or Honor.
gain.collections: Collections: 4 consecutive values in the Palace or the Jungle earn the reward of the matching Collection token.

round.win: After 9 turns, the player with the most Prestige wins the round.
round.tie: In case of a tie, the player with the most Honor wins. If the tie persists, the players reveal the last card in their hand: the winner of this final duel wins the round.
round.after: “Favor fades, but Honor endures!” Favor is discarded, and Honor becomes Favor for the next round.

prestige-total.game: The winner of a round receives one half of the golden elephant. The first player to gather both halves, by winning two rounds, wins the game.

round-victory.title: Round Victory
round-victory.intro: Haati is played as best of three rounds.

rule.round: The winner of a round receives a Round Victory token.
rule.two: A player who wins the first two rounds wins the game.
rule.third: Otherwise, a 3<sup>rd</sup> round decides between the players: its winner takes their opponent’s token and wins the game.

board.title: The duel of the Maharajas
board.intro: A round is played in 9 turns. Each turn goes in this order:
board.refill-title: 4. Refilling your hand: the loser chooses!
board.choose: Each player chooses one of their two Animal cards and may add a Character card, face down.
board.duel: The Elephant beats the Tiger, the Tiger beats the Mouse, the Mouse beats the Elephant. Between two animals of the same family, the highest value wins.
board.effects: The winner places their card in their Palace and must apply its effect. Then the loser places theirs in their Jungle and may apply its effect. Each player then checks their Collections (4 consecutive values).
board.refill: The loser chooses one of the two face-up cards and leaves the other one to their opponent.
board.end: After 9 turns, the player with the most Prestige (Favor + Honor) wins the round. Favor is discarded, Honor becomes Favor. The game is played as best of three rounds.

tuto.universe: In the lavish courts of the Maharajas, the finest strategists face off through their sacred animals: the Elephant, the Tiger and the Mouse.
tuto.favor-honor: You will have to earn Favor and Honor points to gain Prestige.
tuto.prestige: The duelist with the most Prestige points wins the round.
tuto.end-of-game: The first to win 2 rounds wins the game!
tuto.turns: A round is played in 9 turns: here is the current turn. Each new turn is also announced in the middle of the table.
tuto.deck-counters: The deck counters show the remaining cards: when the decks are empty, it is the last turn!
tuto.hand: Here is your hand: two Animal cards. Each turn, both players secretly choose an animal for the duel.
tuto.play: Time for a duel! Play your Elephant 2. Each card belongs to a family and has a value: more on that later.
tuto.cycle: Your animals face off according to a simple rule: the Elephant beats the Tiger, the Tiger beats the Mouse, and the Mouse beats the Elephant. At any time, you can click an element to find out what it is for.
tuto.palace: You won! Your card is placed in your Palace and triggers its effect: the Elephant earns 1 Favor per Elephant in your Palace, so you gain 1 Favor.
tuto.jungle: Your opponent lost: they place their card in their Jungle, on their side of the board, and may apply its effect too. Here, the Tiger lets them move a card from a Palace to a Jungle! A card always stays on its player’s side: cards can never be swapped between the two players’ Palaces and Jungles.
tuto.change-place: Your opponent decided to move your Elephant to your Jungle. Watch out: a card that changes area does not trigger its effect!
tuto.refill: Once the duel and the effects are resolved, each player takes one of the Animal cards face up on the decks. The loser of the duel chooses first: so you will get the other card.
tuto.tiger-beats-mouse: The Tiger beats the Mouse: your opponent wins the duel. The winner always resolves the Palace effects first: their Tiger earns them 1 Favor per Tiger in their Jungle, then makes them draw a Character card.
tuto.mouse-jungle: Losing a duel is not always bad: your Mouse goes to your Jungle and makes you draw a Character card.
tuto.character-piles: Here are the Character deck and its discard pile.
tuto.character: Did you notice the Character card that joined your hand? You can pair it with your Animal card to bet on the outcome of the duel! I will tell you more at the next duel.
tuto.choose-card: This time, you lost: you choose first the card that completes your hand. Take the Elephant 4, and your opponent will then take the Mouse 6.
tuto.bet: A Character card is played face down, in addition to the animal. It is a bet on your victory or your defeat . If you win your bet, you activate the Character’s effect; otherwise, the card is discarded. For example, the Merchant earns you 2 Favor if you win your duel.
tuto.play-merchant: Add your Merchant to bet on your victory.
tuto.same-family: The same animal on both sides: the highest value wins. Each family has cards numbered from 1 to 8: your Elephant 4 beats your opponent’s Elephant 3!
tuto.bet-won: You won the duel: your bet succeeded! You will be able to activate your Merchant.
tuto.resolution-order: With a won bet, you choose the order of resolution. First place your Elephant in your Palace: it earns 1 Favor per Elephant in your Palace, that is 1 Favor.
tuto.activate-merchant: Now activate your Merchant: she earns you 2 Favor, then goes to the discard pile.
tuto.collections: Gather 4 consecutive values in your Palace or in your Jungle, whatever the family, to win the matching Collection token and its reward. Look at your Jungle: you already have the 1 and the 2!
tuto.lose-to-win: The Elephant beats the Tiger: your opponent places their Elephant in their Palace and gains 1 Favor. Your Tiger goes to your Jungle… with the 3!
tuto.tiger-effect: The Tiger’s Jungle effect lets you, in turn, move an animal from a Palace to a Jungle. Move your Elephant 4 from your Palace to your Jungle.
tuto.collection-won: 1, 2, 3, 4: your Jungle forms a Collection! You win the Jungle Collection token and its reward: 3 Favor and 1 Honor.
tuto.honor: Your first Honor! Honor (black tokens) counts towards your Prestige like Favor and breaks ties. At the end of the round, Favor is lost, but Honor becomes Favor for the next round.
tuto.prestige-total: You have 7 Favor and 1 Honor, so your Prestige is 8!
tuto.your-turn: Your turn to play the end of the round: 5 turns left! Remember: click any game element (card, token, board, counter) to show its help.
